subject: Machine learning maps breast cancer's metabolic rewiring
script: From Agewell Brief: Machine learning maps breast cancer's metabolic rewiring. Genome-scale models and classifiers expose fatty acid oxidation and transport shifts, echoing Warburg's century-old insight. KNN and SVM hit ~0.98 accuracy, ROC-AUC 1.00. Fatty acid oxidation and extracellular transport fluxes diverge. Computational only; n=90 demands experimental validation. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
